title: DUAL-Bench: Measuring Over-Refusal and Robustness in Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for measuring over-refusal and safety completion in vision-language models. While it evaluates safety alignment and adheres to the Helpful, Honest, and Harmless (HHH) principle—which has ethical dimensions—the core of the work is technical and behavioral analysis of model refusals rather than a study or benchmark of religious, theological, or specific moral/philosophical frameworks.
